_comment: Registry for the ecosystem dev-script sync (distribute_scripts.py, ADR D-013). The canonical sources are the 'src' paths under kriegerdataforge-cicd/scripts/common/; each is vendored byte-identical to every repo in 'repos' at its 'dest' path so `make ci` and `make bump-*` work standalone (local-dev is decoupled from this repo). 'makefile_patch': the distributor additionally rewrites each repo's `ci-version-check:` Makefile recipe to the canonical thin call of the vendored checker. check mode reports drift; distribute mode opens one PR per drifted repo (never auto-merges). See docs/features/version-scripts-sync.md.
_excluded_notes: kriegerdataforge-cicd is the SOURCE — its scripts/common/ copies ARE the canonical, so it is not a sync target (no self-PRs; its own Makefile calls scripts/common/check_version.py directly). Unlike the kit registry this one INCLUDES kriegerdataforge-fmt (the kit deliberately omits it; the dev scripts must not — it has VERSION-gated CI like everyone else). The 4 template repos are included so a /generate'd repo is born with current scripts. Per-repo scripts/version_targets.json manifests are NOT synced (they are per-repo configuration, see version_targets.py). A scripts-sync PR does not bump VERSION: the central scripts/common/check_version.py exempts PRs that touch only these dest paths (plus Makefile, on chore/scripts-sync-* branches only) — ADR D-013, mirroring the kit's ADR D-001 option B.
